attributes.action: A General Election Must Follow the Prime Minister’s Resignation!
attributes.additional_details: Keir Starmer has rightly resigned, but the UK must not receive another unelected Prime Minister. Repeated changes without public consent undermine democratic trust. Working people deserve leadership chosen by voters, not by internal party decisions. We call for a general election so the next Prime Minister has a clear and legitimate mandate from the electorate.
attributes.background: We welcome Keir Starmer’s decision to resign — it was the right thing to do. But Britain must not be given yet another unelected Prime Minister. The public deserves a choice. For the future of our children and grandchildren, we call for an immediate general election.
